messages:
anya: Quick sync: new compact control for min/max + ramp-rate in the Dedicated panel. Two questions: label the control 'Ramp rate' or 'Scale smoothing'? and should favorites (star) be per-pool or global?
tom: Vote for 'Ramp rate' 11 infra will grok it. 'Scale smoothing' sounds like UX jargon.
lee: Favorites should be per-pool. Teams pick a primary pool by workload. If we default to global, people will accidentally route critical traffic to wrong pools.
anya: Good. Design details: star chip floats favorite pools to top, shows last 1h p95 latency inline and a small cost indicator. Accessibility: star must be keyboard-focusable, aria-pressed, and 44px target.
sam: Copy tweak for SLO slider: change 'Target latency' -> 'SLO latency (p99) 1 ms'. Make the guardrail presets explicit: 'Low-latency', 'Balanced', 'Cost-saving'.
lee: Presets must be real radio buttons in a radio group with a legend, not custom divs. Screen readers need that semantic. Also wire aria-describedby from the slider to the preset explanation text.
a11y-bot: Colors: star yellow (#FFC700) on white fails AA. Recommend darker accent (#D89A00) or add a strong outline. Ensure preset chip text contrast >4.5:1.
tom: Implementation question: ramp-rate unit should be 'GPU cores / min' for Dedicated to match billing. Inline subcopy: 'Limits how quickly capacity can increase (GPU cores/min)'.
anya: Decision: label 'Ramp rate', unit 'GPU cores/min', favorites per-pool, presets as radios, star accessible with aria-pressed and 44px hit. I'll update the Figma and PR. Any objections?
lee: One more: when stepper hits Max, don't move focus. Show inline hint 'Reached max 1 consider enabling burst override' with a learn-more link.
sam: Agreed. Programmatic focus on stepper changes is a no. Use polite aria-live for announcements.
anya: Thanks all 1 I'll push an iteration tonight and link it here. https://www.figma.com/file/new-ramp-proto
